## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Sep 5, 2026 - Nov 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _SATeach_, Nov 2, 2026, 1/5: "I have continued to have issues with the app since September 28 after starting a new plan. I reached out to support. Four days later I heard from someone about an update which I had already completed. I heard back the following day asking if it worked. No it did not was my response. Another three days pass and asked if I was still having issues. I said yes the same issues persisted. So here I am four days later (week 2 from reporting issues) and have yet to hear back at all. So disappointed!"
            2. _Pboswells_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used Runkeeper for 13 years. Latest update has broken indoor runs as it no longer records heartbeat, no longer syncs to Apple Watch, no longer records workout to Apple Health. Logged issue weeks ago but no fix. Essentially useless for indoor runs now."
            3. _LoveSnow12_, Oct 22, 2026, 3/5: "Hi thank you for fixing my recent App glitch for the paid subscription I’ve held form many years. While you remedied the situation to my satisfaction, the time it took to do so in an app I rely on every day could be improved upon. (6 day lag time on fixing a tech issue on a tech app)🤯"
